title: 613 (City Of Manchester) Squadron
memorial_details: A stone of remembrance in grey granite. Polished front face, rough hewn edges; with rounded top corners and squadron badge at the top centre. The incised lettering is in white.
inscription: 613 (CITY OF MANCHESTER) SQUADRON /ROYAL AUXILIARY AIR FORCE /WAS FORMED HERE AT RINGWAY /ON 1st MARCH 1939 /This Commemorative Stone /Is Dedicated To All Those Who /Served With The Squadron /And Is A Memorial To /Those Who Gave Their Lives/ 1939 - 1957 /OPERATIONAL AIRCRAFT /HIND MUSTANG /HECTOR MOSQUITO /LYSANDER SPITFIRE /TOMAHAWK VAMPIRE
